approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 binary with the ReXGlue SDK, native Linux AppImage with Qt launcher, FSR upscaling and frame limiter
notes: Linux v1.0 released (x86_64 AppImage with Qt launcher). The game boots, runs and is fully playable; 120 Hz and high-refresh timing polish and the native Vulkan renderer migration are still in progress. No game data is included - supply your own copy.
